objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Get code execution through the decompressor and read /flag inside the challenge's sandbox.
hints: The compressor shows you the format: study how a back-reference is encoded.
Ask what the decompressor checks, and does not check, when it copies a back-reference.

steps.title: Name the compression family
steps.prompt: Which classic compression family do the format's back-references come from? (name)

steps.title: Find the buffers
steps.prompt: In which memory region do the decompressor's buffers live?

steps.title: Name the bug
steps.prompt: What memory-safety bug class does an unchecked back-reference cause?

steps.title: Name the technique
steps.prompt: Which code-reuse technique turns control of the stack into execution? (acronym)
